subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should onProgressNarratorLifecycle, isProgressDraftVisible, and progressPreambleEnabled become the supported plugin SDK seam for channel-owned progress lifecycle behavior?
rationale: The runtime fix is well-defined, but publishing three new optional reply callbacks creates a durable external contract whose long-term ownership cannot be decided from tests alone.

options.title: Accept the additive SDK seam
options.body: Keep the three optional fields, document their lifecycle contract, and require the API baseline plus bundled-channel boundary checks before merge.

options.title: Internalize the lifecycle
options.body: Replace the three public fields with a narrower existing callback or internal facade before landing, avoiding a broader permanent plugin contract.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Hold the PR until channel and plugin SDK owners agree on one consolidated progress-lifecycle abstraction.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the three optional fields, document their lifecycle contract, and require the API baseline plus bundled-channel boundary checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked issue, assignment, and current branch history make this person the clearest available owner of the proposed progress UX and SDK boundary.
